dedupe_keys.name: a dataset of the operating station heat rate for 806 indian coal plant units using machine learning

description: A Dataset of the Operating Station Heat Rate for 806 Indian Coal Plant Units using Machine Learning is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Yifu Ding, Jansen Wong (MIT Energy Initiative, Massachusetts Institute of Technology). India aims to achieve net-zero emissions by 2070 and has set an ambitious target of 500 GW of renewable power generation capacity by 2030. Coal plants currently contribute to more than 60% of India’s electricity generation in 2022. Upgrading and decarbonizing high-emission coal plants became a pressing energy issue. Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
